d:
Bihar ki rajniti men ek bar phir nitish kumar ke agle rajnitik kadam ko lekar charchaen tej hain. nishant kumar ko lekar RJD ki or se aae ophar ke bad saval uth raha hai ki kya nitish kumar koee naya siyasi phaisla lenge?
Kya nitish kumar phir badlenge pala ya nishant ke siyasi bhavishy ko lekar RJD ke prastav par koee pratikriya denge?
Samjhie RJD ke ophar ke pichhe ki puri rajniti aur iske sanbhavit siyasi mayne
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
